codeSpark: The Award-Winning Learn-to-Code App for Kids (Ages 3–10)

🌟 100s of coding games & activities—plus tools to create your own! Kids as young as 3 can start coding through play with puzzles, storytelling, and creativity tools designed just for them. Older kids can design and publish their own games, join monthly contests, and explore projects created by other kid coders.

Get full access with a monthly or annual subscription—try membership free for 7 days! Annual subscribers can create up to 5 child profiles, making codeSpark perfect for families with multiple learners.

OR play limited content through Hour of Code with no credit card required.

🎮 Learn Coding Through Play
 ✔ Puzzles – Master core coding and problem-solving concepts level by level
 ✔ Create – Design and code your own games and interactive stories
 ✔ Made by Kids – Play and explore games created by other young coders around the world
 ✔ Monthly Coding Contests – Showcase creativity, code projects, and win prizes
 ✔ Code Together – Join friends in a multiplayer water balloon fight while practicing coding logic
 ✔ Pre-Coding for Preschoolers – Activities designed for early learners ages 3–4
 ✔ Adventure Maps – Unlock new puzzles and challenges while progressing through fun coding worlds

📚 Educational Benefits Backed by Research
 codeSpark’s curriculum is based on research from MIT, Princeton, and Carnegie Mellon. Kids learn the basics of computer science in a fun, accessible way—without words.
 ✔ Coding concepts: sequencing, loops, conditionals, events, and debugging
 ✔ Computational thinking: problem-solving, logic, pattern recognition, and creativity
 ✔ Reinforces early skills: reading, math, and critical thinking
 ✔ Builds confidence, perseverance, and collaboration through play
 ✔ Encourages design thinking by letting kids turn ideas into working games and stories

🔒 Kid-Safe & Ad-Free
 ✔ Every game and story is reviewed before publishing to ensure safety
 ✔ No ads, no micro-transactions, no distractions
 ✔ Parent dashboard to manage profiles and track progress
 ✔ A trusted environment for independent learning

💬 Praise from Parents & Teachers
 “My daughters are 6 and 8, and this is their new favorite game. Now they want to be programmers!” – Parent Review
 
“I loved seeing how my children enjoyed working together on the puzzles.” – Parent Review

Teachers and parents worldwide use codeSpark to introduce coding in classrooms, after-school programs, and at home. Kids stay motivated because the learning feels like play, and they are proud to share their creations.

🏆 Awards & Recognition
✅ The LEGO Foundation – Pioneer in Reimagining Learning & Play
🎖️ Children’s Technology Review – Editor’s Choice Award
🥇 Parent’s Choice Award – Gold Medal
🏅 Collision Conference – Kids & Family Silver Winner

🚀 Why Families Choose codeSpark
 ✔ Designed for kids ages 3–10 with no reading required
 ✔ Builds STEM skills through fun, engaging coding challenges
 ✔ Supports creativity with open-ended game and story design tools
 ✔ Encourages collaboration through multiplayer games and contests
 ✔ Trusted by parents, teachers, and schools worldwide
 ✔ Helps kids see themselves as creators, problem-solvers, and future innovators

📥 Subscription & Download
Start with a 7-day free membership trial. Subscriptions renew automatically; manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings. Annual subscribers can create up to 5 child profiles, making it easy to support the whole family.

🛡️ Privacy Policy: http://codespark.com/privacy/
📜 Terms of Use: http://codespark.com/terms/

⭐ Start your child’s coding journey today with codeSpark—the award-winning learn-to-code app that makes programming fun, safe, and accessible for every kid ages 3–10!
